title: Inference: the gateway and inference-aware routing
purpose: Send requests through the gateway to two model replicas. Compare how much of each prompt was already cached when the endpoint picker chose the replica, against a plain Kubernetes Service in front of the same pods.

cache hit rate: gateway 0.822 vs plain Service 0.654

checks.because: The Deployment asks Kueue for two GPUs; the serving queue owns two.

checks.description: the endpoint picker scores replicas on queue depth, KV-cache use and prefix-cache match
checks.because: These are the chart's default plugins for vLLM.

checks.description: a chat request through the gateway returns the right answer
checks.because: Gateway -> HTTPRoute -> InferencePool -> endpoint picker -> a vLLM replica, then back.

checks.description: every request succeeded on both paths
the endpoint picker found at least 10 points more of each prompt already cached than a plain Service did
checks.because: It sends follow-up questions to the replica that already holds the document's KV cache; a plain Service spreads them over both replicas, so a document is often computed on both.

checks.description: time to first token was lower through the picker
checks.because: A cached prefix skips most of the prompt processing, which is what the first token waits for.
